text: DeleteButton sends cmd_deleteMessage or cmd_shiftDeleteMessage, preserving the Shift and string-valued IMAP-deleted guard. This keeps message deletion in the message command family when the attachment controller has focus: AttachmentListController handles generic cmd_delete/cmd_shiftDelete as attachment deletion and does not support the message-specific names. The message controller owns delegation, confirmation and advancing the selection. Keep the command namespace tied to the action this toolbar promises; this is not a blanket rename for every Delete surface.
title: Unified toolbar Delete uses message-specific commands when an attachment has focus
